messages.subject: Tukey Kramer test using JGR
messages.body_plain: Hello, I'm trying to run a Tukey Kramer test in conjunction with an ANOVA test using r and JGR. I can't figure out how to access and run the tests from the drop down menus in JGR. Any help finding the tests in the drop down menus and/or writing the code for the Tukey Kramer test would be greatly appreciated! Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: Tukey Kramer test using JGR
messages.body_plain:
One way of doing this is, going to Menu, Analysis, Linear Model, enter the parameters, hit continue, then click on post hoc and select from a number of available tests "Tuckey" before proceeding to finally run the model.

And no plot is generated. Is Deducer not fully compatible with R 3.2.3? Or is there some other likely diagnosis?

messages.subject: Re: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult" when trying to use Deducer to plot anything
messages.subject_clean: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult" when trying to use Deducer to plot anything
messages.body_plain:
Richard,

There was recently a new version of ggplot2 released that had a number of API changes requiring non-trivial changes in Deducer. I’ve submitted an updated version to CRAN, which should be pushed out in the next few days.

Best,
Ian
